discription: A bright, buzzy saw wave sound with an ADSR envelope and a low-pass filter to control its brilliance.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, cutoff=8000, rq=0.5; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.005, 0.15, 0.7, 0.8, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = SawOsc.ar(freq); sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
